text: A song of ascents. 1 I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
My help comes from the LORD {YHWH}, the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
Behold, the Protector of Israel (he wrestles with God) will neither slumber nor sleep.
The LORD {YHWH} is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
The LORD {YHWH} will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
The LORD {YHWH} will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
